annotations.title: Estimate the price to make public PDFs accessible

description: For one to five links to PDFs on public websites, checks whether each file qualifies and returns a price estimate from CyberNative AI LLC's published Terms for the same PDF with tags added: USD 4 per page, minimum USD 100 per order. Names each file that does not qualify, such as a scanned file, a fillable form, a map or drawing, or a file over 35 pages, with the reason, and does not price it. The estimate is not binding and nothing is ordered by calling this tool; the price is confirmed by email before any work. Use when the user asks what it would cost to have these PDFs made accessible.

detail.description: When true, adds the page-by-page price for each file that qualifies.

urls.description: One to five links to PDFs on public websites: http or https, at most 2,048 characters each.
